title: It was fun
text: It was a blast.  We got off the route for a while but found our way back and got back to the rental place in time and safely.  My only issue was we were struck at red lights too much.  Traffic control in Barcelona sux.  Bottom line, it was fun and I recommend checking it out.
author: 62lennyc

title: Must Try!
text: If you’re visiting Barcelona then don’t miss out😍 One of the best experiences I’ve had! First of all, the staff was very helpful, they explained everything we needed to know in detail and they were friendly too. The GoCar was easy to drive and the GPS was clear, accurate, and interesting too, telling you all you need to know about Barcelona and some famous landmarks. I’d definitely try this activity again😍
author: ashkananim

title: Great experience, a lot of fun.
text: This was an excellent experience for our family. The staff was very helpful and we actually had an issue with one of our cars, but they delivered a new car to us in less than 10 minutes! Would definitely recommend this for your Barcelona trip!
author: Hicksy1974

title: Great fun
text:
We booked a 3 hour tour and had,a great time. It was raining on the day and we were offered the chance to change the day but as,we,were traveling home the next day we stuck with it and,the,rain did not ruin the day.
The roads are quite busy so you need to be confident and the GPS sometimes,a little slow so we lost track a little but still had the best time. Staff were great really had no problems at all. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting as you get to see lots more than you would just walking.
author: rhughes80

title: A unique way to see the city
text: The cars were a fun way to see the city and then decide what to spend more time at. The route was well laid out and the GPS guide relativity easy and the commentary was informative.
author: Ian M
